svg.title: Motion graphics came first
svg.desc: Motion graphics came first. Timing, rhythm, hierarchy, and transitions, applied to software.

g.data-lettering: Before software took over most of my time,
g.aria-label: Before software took over most of my time,
g.title: Before software took over most of my time,

g.data-lettering: I was doing motion graphics and video editing.
g.aria-label: I was doing motion graphics and video editing.
g.title: I was doing motion graphics and video editing.

g.data-lettering: I still care way too much about timing, rhythm,
g.aria-label: I still care way too much about timing, rhythm,
g.title: I still care way too much about timing, rhythm,

g.data-lettering: Now I just apply the same brain to software.
